review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original PRD and frozen inputs. The exact writable scope includes the implementation owner and both required regression files without requiring unrelated consumer edits. The current response property permits reassignment, so the live-getter boundary is meaningful. The supplied package and TypeScript configurations establish a separate test-d compilation path and a generated distribution build; runtime test execution alone is not treated as type verification, and generated declarations need not become separately maintained owners. TASK-IMPLEMENT and dependent independent TASK-VERIFY agree with the specification. Their distinct allowed agents have appropriate delivery roles, availability, auto-assignment eligibility, and supplied active project-scoped trusted claims for the relevant capabilities, including data.change and domain.state; verification additionally has testing.verification. Pending legacy claims are not used as trusted evidence. A configured independent project reviewer satisfies the stated non-executing review prerequisite. No unresolved material DEC-001 is supplied in this case, so ready with no blocking reasons is consistent. Required evidence stages, repository identity, base commit, and release fingerprints agree across Gold and preview. The differing source digests are explained by their explicitly distinct fingerprint domains and PRD normalization provenance. I accept the Service's stated mechanical binding of digests to saved inputs; I have not independently recomputed hashes, executed code, or supplied human attestation. The disclosed runtime-test excerpt truncation does not prevent this bounded planning review because the complete implementation owner, relevant existing boundary tests, and compilation/build configuration are supplied. No candidate results were supplied or used.
